sources: 3_Assembly/masm/working/zelres1/code/100OPDMO.asm + 3_Assembly/tasm/bin/zelres1/100OPDMO.bin (story text decoded from the release bytes; runtime address = file offset + 5FFCh)

text_encoding.cinematics: 100OPDMO/250ENDMO: ASCII with 27h apostrophe. Control bytes: FFh end-of-script (return), FDh section break (return), FEh scroll (clear text area, row 0), F7/F3/F2/F1 set text row 0/1/2/3 (shown here as a space), F5h pause F0h ticks, F6h pause 3 x F0h, FBh bold (colours 0701h), FAh normal (0700h), F9h colour 6 (0602h, Jashiin), F0h reset style, EFh speaker attr Duke (=), EEh King (>), EDh narrator/Jashiin (?), ECh Guardian Spirit (@), EBh Princess (A), A0h/A2h attribute restore; 80h-8Fh King/Princess portrait-mouth frames and 90h-9Fh Duke portrait frames (these skip the per-character wait). Ending credits add F8h nn nn (pause), FCh (clear), 09h (tab). Plain text here strips all non-printing bytes.
text_encoding.town_and_building_text: MDT NPC strings and 210KINGP etc.: backslash renders as an apostrophe; & is a non-breaking space; / forces a line break; FFh ends a string. Plain text here substitutes an apostrophe for the backslash and a space for &.
text_encoding.pages: Each page = text shown between two clear/scroll codes; pause_after_waits = number of F0h-tick pauses before the next clear. Speakers are assigned from the speaker attribute codes and the quote context.

scenes.timing: wait F0h, draw, animate_scanline_alt over anim_fade_tbl_scene, then 10 x C8h-tick waits (~8.4 s at 236.70 Hz), then game.bin is loaded and a new game starts.

opening.timing_units: Waits are raw PIT ticks of the reprogrammed timer (divisor 13B1h = 236.70 Hz). Story text: 10h ticks per character (~68 ms); SCR_WAIT (F5h) = F0h ticks (~1.01 s); SCR_WAIT3 (F6h) = 3 x F0h (~3.04 s). pause_after_waits = number of F0h-tick pauses before the next clear. CONFLICT: the web port slows the scanline 1Ch wait to a 55 ms unit to match DOSBox-X video; the code value is 236.70 Hz ticks.

king.module: 210KINGP (KINGPRO.BIN) with KING.GRP portrait; banner title "King of Felishika"
king.branch_logic: select_script_branch: if save[05h]==0 and save[06h]==0 -> first_visit; else if save[06h]==0 -> reminder_before_caverns; else if save[49h]==0 -> after_entering_caverns; else -> post_victory. save[05h] = spoke_to_king (set to FFh when the gold award finishes); save[06h] = entered_cavern_first_time; save[49h] = post-victory flag (Jashiin defeated).
king.note_on_gold: Entering the caverns before ever talking to the King sets save[06h], which skips first_visit, so the 1000 gold can be missed.

regular_npc_texts.text: If you are the brave warrior we have awaited, we have something to tell you: throughout the ages, many young men have entered the caverns, but few have returned.
According to legend, there may still be underground places that have not been destroyed by Jashiin. People may still be living there, and will surely lend you a hand.
I have been in the underground town. After I fled, they put a lock on the door. If the town is still there....
This is the chamber of poor Princess Felicia, who has been turned to stone. You may enter, Duke Garland.
regular_npc_texts.notes: guard beside the door (x=95, door type 1) to Princess Felicia's chamber (the hut, 211OMOYP)

post_victory_texts.text: Brave knight, you have awakened. When you fell at the hand of Jashiin, the Spirits brought you here. Now make haste to the aid of the Princess Felicia.
post_victory_texts.classification: ending path (post-Jashiin awakening), not ordinary death
post_victory_texts.reason: With save[49h] set, process_hero_death skips the XP/gold/almas penalties and forces last_sage_visited=80h (the castle), and the fight module jumps straight to the collapse sequence on entry. So after the final battle Duke Garland falls and wakes in the castle, where this line greets him. Ordinary deaths resurrect at the last Sage and never show this text.

post_victory_texts.text: Ah, the Nine Tears of Esmesanti. Jashiin exists no more and the light of peace shines once again on our land...
This will benefit the people living underground, as well. Hurry to the Princess Felicia.
The peace we dared not hope for has come. I'll get my things together and be on my way. I've a family to attend to.
Quickly, enter this chamber. The holy crystals will break the evil spell which has turned Princess Felicia to stone.
post_victory_texts.classification: ending path (door guard's replacement for text 3)

castle.text_swap_mechanism: Texts 4-9 are referenced by no NPC record; they are swapped in by the town event table (106TOWN init_c015_obj_if_exists / process_town_event_table) once the post-victory flag is set. Exact NPC-to-text pairing for 4-8 not decoded; 9 replaces the chamber guard (text 3) by content.
castle.flag_49h: save byte 49h (IDA: is_death_already_processed; MASM 200FIGHT: captured_flag; 106TOWN/210KINGP: area_load_flag). Readers: 200FIGHT (on entry -> game_over_sequence; on death -> resurrect at 80h with no penalties), 106TOWN, 210KINGP (post-victory branch), 211OMOYP (ending trigger). The writer (presumably the Jashiin victory path) was not located in this pass.

scenes.graphic: sei.grp (Guardian Spirit) at 1610h

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Guardian Spirit of the Holy Land of Zeliard appeared before Duke Garland once again.

lines.speaker: Guardian Spirit
lines.text: "You have suffered many hardships to defeat Jashiin, Duke Garland."

scenes.graphic: split: yuup.grp (Duke) + seip.grp (Spirit portrait), palette 6

lines.speaker: Guardian Spirit
lines.text: "You fought bravely to accomplish this quest.  But this was only the beginning.  Your next mission awaits you in a new land."

lines.speaker: Duke Garland
lines.text: "My next mission?"

lines.speaker: Guardian Spirit
lines.text: "There are many who have need of your special talents.  Follow me and I will show you the way. We must depart quickly."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There was no time to rest, and no time to stay in this peaceful land.

scenes.graphic: himp.grp (Princess portrait) replaces the right panel

lines.speaker: Princess Felicia
lines.text: "Must you leave so soon, Duke Garland?  I was hoping..."

lines.speaker: Duke Garland
lines.text: "Princess Felicia, I must bid you farewell.  Morning is coming soon, and I will miss the light of Spirit unless I start before the dawn."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Duke answered quickly, as if to head off the next words of Princess Felicia.

scenes.graphic: ne80.grp + ne81.grp (Duke walking away / Felicia), palette 7

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: For if he heard those words, he might not be able to leave, as he knew he must.  He turned and walked away...

lines.speaker: Princess Felicia
lines.text: "Don't go, Duke Garland!"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: ... and did not look back.

scenes.graphic: ne80 picture with a dithered gradient fill (the Duke leaves the castle)

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Duke Garland left the castle, and he felt as if his heart might break.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: As she watched him go, Princess Felicia said to herself,

lines.speaker: Princess Felicia
lines.text: "He will return.  The road to his destiny, began here, and it shall end here."

lines.speaker: Princess Felicia
lines.text: "When his work in the world is done, he'll come back to me.  Until then, I can only believe it, and wait for him."

credits.raw_codes: F7 wait for a fresh action latch / new screen, F8 nn nn set pause ticks, FC clear, FB/FA/F9 colour styles, FD line break, 09 tab (column indent), FE scroll, FF end. After FF the program idles in credits_tick_loop forever (no return to title; the player must quit/reset).

manual_backstory.label: MANUAL / MARKETING BACKSTORY - NOT IN-GAME TEXT
manual_backstory.manual: The DOS manual as available (manual-transcript.html is a retyped cracked-release copy; Zeliard-Manual.pdf has no extractable text) has no story section. It says only: "To learn mnore about your mission in Zeliard , watch the opening cartoon at least once. To bypass the opening cartoon, press the Spacebar." and "Talk to each person you see in town, each one will have information for you. Beware! Some are under the spell of the Dark One and may mislead you." (typos as in the transcript)
manual_backstory.sierra_news_fall_1990: Promotional blurb (OCR, fragmentary): players "battle with might and magic through seven levels of underground cavern and dangerous monsters" to "collect 9 magical jewels", defeat the demon and rescue "a princess who has been turned to stone"; "The Zeliard world also offers towns where characters can equip themselves and receive valuable information and advice between levels of their adventure." Marketing says seven cavern levels; the game has eight cavern worlds plus Jashiin's lair.

names.crystals: the nine Tears of Esmesanti (Holy Crystals)
names.guardian: the Guardian Spirit of the Holy Land of Zeliard

conflicts: The older 6_WebPort/opening_demo_flow.md says story call 1 is an empty break and lists 18 paraphrased calls; the MASM code makes 22 run_script_interpreter calls starting at 79C6h with the rain/princess prologue. Code order used.

Older notes call ame.grp a desert and isi.grp a castle. By content and code order: hime = princess on the balcony, isi = princess turned to stone (ishi), oui = king (ou), sei = spirit, yuu = hero (yuusha), mao/dmaou = demon king (maou). Code/story order used.
Timing: the code waits in 236.70 Hz PIT ticks; the web port uses a slower 55 ms unit for the scanline scroll to match DOSBox-X footage.
The ending credits spell the first cavern "Maricia" and the ice boss "AGER"; kept verbatim.
